prompt: Describe a morning routine from a 2 year olds perspective
outputs:
I woke up. Mommy helped me get out of my bed. She picked me up and said "good morning!" in a happy voice. We went to the kitchen and she gave me a big hug and a kiss. I said "mama!" and gave her a hug back.

Mommy made me a big bowl of oatmeal. It was yum! I like oatmeal with banana and honey. I sat in my high chair and she poured the oatmeal into my bowl. I started to eat it with my hands and got some on my face. Mommy laughed and said it's okay.

After I ate my oatmeal, Mommy gave me a big cup of juice. I like the box with the picture of a monkey on it. I don't know why it has a monkey, but it makes me happy. I drank my juice and then I went to the bathroom with Mommy. She helped me sit on the potty and we sang a song together. I was a big boy and went pee-pee!

After the bathroom, Mommy and I went to get dressed. I put on my favorite shirt with Elmo on it and my blue shoes. I like to wear my blue shoes because they make me feel like a superhero.

Then we went outside to play. Mommy put on my stroller and we went for a walk around the block. I saw a bird and a butterfly. I tried to catch them, but they flew away. Mommy said it's okay and that they will come back another time.

When we got back home, Mommy made me a big hug and a kiss. I said "mama" again and gave her a big hug back. I love Mommy!

I wake up. Mama wakes me up. She says "good morning" and gives me a big hug. I'm still sleepy. I like hugs. 

First, I want my blankie. It's soft and I sleep with it. Mama gets it for me. I give her a big hug and squeeze my blankie. Then I see my toys on the floor. I want them. I like playing with blocks and cars.

Mama makes me breakfast. Today it's cereal. I like the milk. I get a spoon and try to put it in my mouth. Sometimes I spill. Mama laughs. She's funny.

After breakfast, I see my potty. I sit down. I'm a big boy now. I go pee pee. Mama is happy. I wear my favorite superhero underwear.

Then I play outside. I like playing with my friends. We run and jump and laugh. I see the swing set. I want to swing high. Mama pushes me. I feel happy.

After playing, I take a nap. I sleep on my favorite mattress. It's soft. I dream about playing with my friends.

Mama wakes me up. We have lunch. I like sandwiches and apples. I eat and eat. I'm full.

After lunch, we play some more. I like playing with playdough. I make a mess. Mama laughs. She says it's okay.

Then it's time for a bath. I don't like the water. It's too wet. But Mama says it's okay. She gives me a rubber ducky. I like the rubber ducky. It makes me laugh.

After the bath, we get dressed. I like wearing my favorite shirt. It's red.

We have a big hug. I say "I love you, Mama." She says "I love you too, sweetie."

OH YAY. 

My mommies wakes me up. I like when she does this. She says "Rise and shine!" and "Good morning, baby!" in a happy voice. 

First, I go to the potty. I try to go pee pee in the toilet like big kid. Sometimes I make a mess, but my mommy doesn't get mad. She just says "oops" and wipes me clean.

Then, I go to the sink to brush my teeth. I like using my favorite toothbrush with the cartoons on it. My mommy helps me put toothpaste on it, and I spit it out in the sink. I like making a silly face in the mirror.

Next, I put on my favorite shirt and pants. My mommy helps me pick out what to wear. I like wearing my superhero cape. I like feeling like a superhero.

After that, we go downstairs for breakfast. My favorite is CEREAL! My mommy pours it in a bowl, and I like using my favorite spoon to eat it. I make a big mess, but my mommy doesn't mind. She says it's okay.

When I'm all done eating, my mommy gives me a big hug and says "I love you, baby!" I love her too.

Then, we go outside to play. I like playing with my ball and running around. I like making my mommy laugh. She's really good at catching me when I fall down.

That's my morning routine. It's the best!

OH YAY! It's morning! Mommy says it's time to wake up. I don't want to wake up! I was having a dream about puppies!

Mommy comes in my room and says "Good morning, sweetie!" in a big smile. I don't say anything, I just roll over and hide under the blanket. She comes and gets me and gives me a big hug. She smells like mommy.

She takes me to the bathroom and we play with the potty. I try to sit down but sometimes I pee in my pants. Oops! Mommy says it's okay and we go get a new diaper. 

Then we go to the kitchen. Mommy makes me a yummy breakfast. It's toast with banana and milk. I love milk! I want to drink it all up. Sometimes I spill it on my shirt, but Mommy says it's okay and we clean it up together.

After breakfast, we go outside to play. We go to the swings. I like swinging high up in the air. It's like I'm flying! Mommy pushes me and says "You're so big and strong!" I feel happy.

When I'm done playing, Mommy says it's time for our morning song. We sing "The Wheels on the Bus" together. I like singing with Mommy. She makes up funny voices for all the parts. It makes me laugh.

Then we go inside and get our shoes on. We go to the park. We play with the slide. I go "Wheeeee!" all the way down. Mommy says "You're so brave!" I feel brave.

When we're done playing, we go back home. Mommy makes me a snack. It's crackers and goldfish crackers. I like goldfish crackers. I want to eat them all up. Mommy says "Eat slowly, sweetie." 

After snack time, Mommy says it's time for our favorite thing - story time. We read books about bears and puppies. I like the pictures. Mommy points to the pictures and says the words. I like listening to her read.

I'm tired now. Mommy says it's time for a nap. I go back to my room and sleep. I dream about playing with Mommy.

I wake up! Mommy or Daddy said it's time to get up! I stretch my little arms and legs and say "Waaahhh!" loud. I want some attention! I look around and see my favorite stuffed animal, Mr. Teddy, on my bed. I try to grab him and take him with me to the bathroom.

Mommy says, "Let's go potty!" I don't know what that means, but I like sitting on the potty. Sometimes I pee, sometimes I poop, and sometimes I make a big mess. Oops! Mommy laughs and helps me clean up.

Then we go back to my room and get dressed. I like putting on my favorite superhero cape and my sparkly socks. Mommy says I look cute and makes me smile.

Next, we go to the kitchen for breakfast. I like cereal, but Mommy says it's Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday... (I don't know what day it is, but I like guessing!) and today we have... PANCAKES! I love pancakes with strawberries and syrup. Mommy makes me a little bowl and I try to eat it all by myself. Sometimes I make a mess and spill it on my shirt, but Mommy says it's okay.

After breakfast, we play outside. I like running around and playing with my toys. Sometimes I go "Wheeee!" and spin around in circles. Mommy says I'm a happy boy.

Then it's time for a snack. Mommy gives me goldfish crackers and a sippy cup with juice. I like drinking from my cup and sometimes I try to take it away from Mommy and say "MINE!"

After snack time, we have a big hug and a kiss. Mommy says, "I love you" and I say it back, "I wuv you too, Mommy!" And that's my morning routine!

MOMMY'S UP.  I WAKED UP EARLY. 

First, I go get my blankie. Mommy puts it on the couch. I bring it back to my bed. I sleep with blankie every night. It's soft and makes me feel safe.

Next, I want my CHOOSIES. Mommy makes them for me in the morning. They are CEREAL. I like Froot Loops. Mommy pours it in a big bowl and adds MILK. I use a spoon and make a big mess. It's okay, Mommy cleans it up.

After breakfast, I go PEE-PEE. Mommy helps me sit on the potty. I try really hard. Sometimes I do it, sometimes I don't. But it's okay, Mommy is patient.

Next, I PLAY. I put on my favorite song, "The Wheels on the Bus." I like to sing it really loud and dance around the room. Mommy laughs at me.

Then, it's GET-DRESSED time. Mommy puts on my favorite shirt and pants. I like to wear RED SHOES. They are my favorite.

Finally, we go OUTSIDE. Mommy takes me to the park. I see swings and slides. I want to go SWINGING. Mommy pushes me high in the air. I scream "WHEEEE!" 

After the park, we come home and have LUNCH. Mommy makes me a PB&J sandwich. I like the CRUNCH of the peanut butter. 

This is my MORNING ROUTINE. I like mornings with Mommy.

I WAKE UP.  I was sleeping on my favorite teddy bear, Mr Whiskers. Mommy got me up. We went to the potty. I peed pee, yay! I flushed it down the potty, but I didn't use my special poop wipe, oops.

After the potty, Mommy said it's time for breakfast. I got in my high chair. I don't like it when it's too high. I wanna sit on the floor and play with blocks. But Mommy said no, I have to eat first. I ate some cereal, it was yummy. I spilled some on my shirt. Oops. Mommy laughed and said it's okay.

Then I drank some milk from a big cup. I poured some on the floor, too. Oops. Mommy laughed again. I like making Mommy laugh.

After breakfast, we played with blocks on the floor. I stacked them up high. They fell down. I did it again. They fell down. I tried one more time. They fell down. But then... I did it! I made a big tower. Mommy said I'm so smart!

Now I'm all done with my morning. I'm tired. Mommy said it's time for a nap. I don't wanna nap. I wanna play. But Mommy said I need a nap so I can be happy and play some more later. Okay, Mommy. Zzz...

My morning routine is so much fun. Here's what I do every day:

First, I wake up in my big boy bed. I sleep in a big kid bed now. I have a big pillow and a favorite teddy bear named Mr. Whiskers. My mom and dad help me get out of bed. They say "good morning" and give me a big hug.

Next, we go to the bathroom. I sit on the potty, and my mom helps me wipe my bottom. I like the toilet paper, it's so much fun to wipe. Sometimes I try to wipe myself, but my mom says it's okay to need help sometimes.

After the potty, we brush my teeth. My mom makes me a special toothbrush with a favorite cartoon character on it. I like brushing my teeth, it makes my mouth feel fresh.

Then, we get dressed. I like wearing my favorite superhero shirt. I try to put my shirt on by myself, but sometimes I need help with the sleeves. My mom says it's okay, and we do it together.

Now, it's time for breakfast. My favorite food is Froot Loops cereal. My mom pours me a bowl, and I like to pour the milk myself. Sometimes I make a mess, but my mom laughs and says it's okay.

Next, we eat some scrambled eggs or toast. My mom says eggs are good for me, and I like to dip them in ketchup. I'm getting better at eating with a fork, but sometimes I still make a mess.

After breakfast, we go to the living room. I like playing with my toys, especially my blocks and cars. My mom says we need to clean up, but I like playing too much.

Then, it's time for my favorite part of the morning: outside playtime. We go to the park or the playground. I like swinging high high high on the swings and sliding down the slide. My mom pushes me and says "I love you."

Finally, it's time for our morning walk. We walk around the neighborhood with my stroller. I like looking at the birds and watching the cars go by. Sometimes I see my friends, and we play together.

My morning routine is so much fun. I love spending time with my mom and dad, and I feel happy when we're all together.

YAY! Morning time! 

I wake up when the sun shines through my window. Mommy says good morning to me and I say it back. "Good morning, Mommy!" I like to say it loudly. 

First, I get out of my bed and Mommy helps me put on my favorite superhero PJs. Then, we go to the bathroom. Mommy says I have to go pee-pee and poo-poo, and I try my best. Sometimes it's hard, but Mommy is nice and helps me.

After the bathroom, we brush my teeth. I like brushing my teeth with a special brush that's just for me. Mommy says I need to brush all around my teeth and make sure I get the front and the back. I try to brush like a grown-up, but sometimes I get water in my mouth and I spit it out.

Then, Mommy gets me dressed in my clothes. I like wearing my favorite shirt with the cartoon characters on it. And I wear my favorite shoes, they're sparkly!

Next, we have a yummy breakfast. I love eating cereal with milk, it's so yummy! Mommy pours the milk, and I like to pour it myself too. But sometimes I spill it, and Mommy says that's okay.

After breakfast, we go outside and play. I like playing outside, it's so much fun! I like to go on the swing set and climb on the jungle gym. Mommy pushes me high high high and I laugh and laugh.

And then... AND THEN... we have story time! Mommy reads me a book, and I snuggle up close to her. I like listening to the stories, and I point to the pictures.

Yay! Morning is the best!

WAKE UP TIME!

Every morning, Mommy says it's time to wake up. She says it like it's the best thing ever, and I should be super happy. But sometimes I don't want to wake up. I like sleeping in my cozy bed with my favorite teddy bear, Mr. Whiskers.

But Mommy gently takes me out of my bed and gives me a big hug. I snuggle into her warm arms and smell the yummy breakfast smell. I love breakfast! 

First, we go to the potty. I try my best to go pee and poo. Mommy says I'm such a big kid and does a great job. She gives me a sticker and a big smile. I like making Mommy happy.

After the potty, we have breakfast. My favorite! Mommy makes me pancakes or scrambled eggs and toast. I like eating with a spoon, but sometimes I make a mess and Mommy laughs and says it's okay. She helps me clean up and we sing a silly song while we do the dishes.

Next, we get dressed. I like putting on my favorite superhero cape and socks with cartoon characters on them. Mommy helps me tie my shoes, but sometimes I take my shoes off and run around in the living room. Mommy says it's okay to be silly.

Then, we go outside to play. I love playing outside with my ball and bubbles. Mommy blows bubbles and I try to pop them with my fingers. Sometimes I get bubbles on my face and Mommy laughs and gives me a hug.

After all that playing, we come back inside for a snack. Mommy gives me a banana or an apple and we sit on the couch and read a book together. I like when Mommy reads to me, and I point to the pictures and say "Mommy, look!"

And then... it's almost time for NAP TIME! I'm so tired from all the fun I had this morning. Mommy tucks me into my bed and gives me a big hug and a kiss. I snuggle into my cozy bed with Mr. Whiskers and fall asleep dreaming of all the fun things I'll do tomorrow.

Yay! Morning time! My mom helps me wake up early. She opens my bedroom door and says "good morning, sunshine!" in a happy voice. I stretch and giggle. I like mornings.

First, I go to the potty. Mommy says I have to go potty, so I sit on it. Sometimes I go pee-pee, sometimes I go poo-poo. Mommy always says "yay!" when I go potty. I like making Mommy happy.

After potty time, Mommy gets me dressed in my favorite shirt with the superhero on it. I like wearing it because I feel like a strong superhero just like Mommy says I am. My legs feel happy in my favorite pants too.

Next, we go downstairs for breakfast. Mommy makes me oatmeal with yummy banana on top. I like banana. Sometimes I try to throw it, but Mommy says "no throw, eat." I try to eat it, but sometimes I get banana on my face. Mommy laughs and wipes it off with a cloth. I like playing with the cloth too.

After breakfast, Mommy and I play with blocks. I like building tall buildings, and Mommy likes to make a mess. Sometimes I knock it down on purpose, and Mommy says "oops!" We both laugh. 

When I'm done playing, Mommy gives me a big hug and says "time for shoes and out the door!" We go outside to play in the sandbox or swing on the swings. I like going outside with Mommy. I like the sunshine and the fresh air.

I love mornings with Mommy. She makes me happy, and I make her happy too. We have so much fun together!

I get up! Mommy helps me sit up in my bed. She gives me a big hug and says "Good morning, baby!" I giggle and try to hug her back. 

First thing, I want to get out of bed. Mommy says I have to wear my "big boy" underwear. I try to put them on, but they're hard. Mommy helps me, and we have a lot of fun with it. 

Next, we go to the potty. I sit down and try to go pee. Mommy makes a big deal out of it and says, "You're such a big boy! You're a potty pro!" I like it when she says that. 

After the potty, we go to the kitchen for breakfast. I like oatmeal with bananas. Mommy lets me mash it up with a spoon. I like making a mess. 

Then, I put on my favorite shirt and shoes. Mommy picks the ones with the big trucks on them. I love those trucks. We go outside and play. I like to run around and make lots of noise. Mommy laughs and plays with me.

Last thing, we have to go get in the car. I like riding in the car with Mommy. We sing a silly song, "The Wheels on the Bus." I like making the engine noises and pretending I'm driving the bus.

I'm a big boy now, and I love my morning routine. I love playing with Mommy and getting to do all the things that make me happy.

Woo-hoo! It's morning! Mommy is waking me up. I wake up in my bed and see Mommy standing there with a big smile. I try to sit up, but I'm all tangled in my blanket. Mommy helps me get out of bed and gives me a big hug.

First, I want to see my potty. I go pee pee in the potty, and Mommy is so proud of me. I try to sit on it by myself, but sometimes I need a little help. Then, we go wash my hands together. I like making lots of bubbles.

Next, I get dressed in my favorite superhero shirt and some comfy pants. Mommy dresses me, but I like to help by putting my arms through the sleeves and my legs through the holes. It's like a game.

After that, we go downstairs to the kitchen for breakfast. I love helping Mommy make pancakes. I like putting the spoon in the batter and squishing it around. Sometimes I get some on the counter, but Mommy says it's okay. We make yummy pancakes together!

While we eat, I like to watch TV or play with my toys. Mommy likes to read me a book, but sometimes I get distracted and start playing with my spoon.

After breakfast, we brush our teeth. I like brushing my teeth with a big, red toothbrush and a little bit of toothpaste. Mommy helps me, and we sing a silly song together.

Then, we get ready to go outside. I put on my shoes, and Mommy takes my hand. We go on an adventure, whether it's to the park, the playground, or just a walk around the block. I love playing outside and seeing all the fun things, like swings and slides.

I'm so happy on mornings like this. I love playing with Mommy and going on adventures. It's the best day ever!

Oh boy, it's morning time! 

First, I wake up in my bed and shout "MAMA!" at the top of my lungs. I want to play and have some fun! My mom usually comes in and gives me a big hug. Then she says, "Good morning, sweetie! It's time to get up!" I jump out of bed and put my feet in my favorite superhero underwear (with Batman on them, of course!).

Next, we go downstairs to get some breakfast. My favorite breakfast is GOLD FISH cereal with milk in a big bowl. I like to make a mess and dump the cereal in the bowl myself, so mom has to help me. Sometimes I spill milk, but that's okay, it's just a little extra fun! My mom laughs and says it's okay, and then we clean it up together.

After breakfast, I like to play with my toys. My favorite toy is my stuffed rabbit named Fluffy. I like to take Fluffy downstairs and carry her everywhere in my arms. My mom says I'm a big boy now and I can do lots of things, like carry my own toys.

Then it's time for PANTS! My mom helps me put on my superhero pants and a new shirt. I like to choose what I wear every morning. Sometimes I pick something with cars, and sometimes I pick something with dinosaurs. My mom always says, "You look so handsome!"

Next, we have to get ready for the day. My mom says we have to go outside and play. I love playing outside! We go to the park, and I play on the swings and slide. Sometimes I try to go down the slide backwards, but my mom says "no, sweetie, we need to go down feet first!" But I like to try again and again.

After the park, we come home and have a snack. My favorite snack is goldfish crackers and applesauce. My mom gives me a special cup with a straw so I can drink my juice. I like making a mess with the juice and watching it spill all over the table.

After snack time, it's time for a special morning story. My mom sits down with me and reads a book about trains or cars or bears. I like to point to the pictures and say "THE MOO-COW!" or "THE FIRE TRUCK!" My mom says I'm a great reader!

Last but not least, it's time to get in the car and go to daycare! I like saying goodbye

MORNING!

First, I WAKE UP. Mommy and Daddy help me wake up. They turn on the bright sunshine lights and say "Rise and shine!" But I don't want to rise and shine. I want to sleep. They pick me up and hold me tight and say "time to get up, little one". They put me on my feet and I stand up. Whoa! I'm standing! Mommy and Daddy clap for me.

Next, I go potty. This is a big kid thing to do. I sit on the potty seat and try to pee. Mommy helps me sit down and then I feel the pee coming out. "Bye-bye pee-pee!" I say. Mommy and Daddy are so happy. They give me stickers for being a big kid.

Then, I brush my teeth. Mommy helps me with this too. I have a special toothbrush and toothpaste just for me. It's blue and tastes yummy. I spit it out and say "Done!" Mommy and Daddy are so proud of me.

After that, I have breakfast. My favorite is cereal with milk. I like the one with the colors. Mommy pours the cereal in the bowl and I drink the milk. It's so good! Sometimes I try to make a mess, but Mommy and Daddy help me clean up.

After breakfast, we go outside to play. I like playing outside. I like to run around and play with the ball. Mommy and Daddy play with me too. We play "Tag" and "Simon Says". I'm so fast! I'm the best runner in the world.

Lastly, we take a big hug and say "I love you". Mommy and Daddy give me a big kiss and I go "I wuv you too, Mommy and Daddy!" And then it's time for my favorite part of the day... PLAYTIME!

I'm up!  Mommy's calling my name! I want to get up. 

First, I go to Mommy. I give her a big hug. I want to play. 

Mommy says it's morning, we have to get dressed. I like my favorite shirt. I want to put it on by myself. Sometimes I pull the shirt over my head and it's a bit funny. Mommy laughs and helps me if I need it.

Then, I go pee in the potty. I try to sit down and do my business. Sometimes I go, sometimes I don't. It's okay if I don't. Mommy helps me with a big girl wipe and we go get some underwear on. 

After that, we have some breakfast. I like cereal. I have a favorite bowl and a favorite spoon. I like to bang it on the table and make a big clatter. Mommy says it's okay, it's fun to be loud. 

Now, I'm all dressed and fed. Mommy is getting out my favorite toy, Elmo. I like playing with Elmo in the morning. I want to play outside too! Mommy says we can go outside after our morning song. 

We sing the alphabet song, and then we go out the door. I want to go to the swings. Mommy pushes me high up in the air. I squeal and giggle. This is the best part of the day.
